items.information:
The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded.  First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.

Don't be late! This competition is on the first day of Daylight Savings Time, so make sure you turn your clocks forward so you don't miss the first hour.

items.information:
For Safety Precautions, we ask that competitors and their one guest only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. 

* Please review the COVID precautions tab for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition.
* Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.
* Please review the competitor information tab before the competition.

**STAFF**
Please contact us if you are interested. You must be able to staff for the entire competition. Staff will pay registration and have it refunded upon completion of staffing for the competition.

items.name: Pittsburgh Winter 2022
items.information:
# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, February 27th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, March 9th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. 
#####
